spans.s: Jest,Ⓒs.Ⓓpari(rI)hAsaH, narman n., hAsyaM, vi-nodokti f., prahasanaM, vinodaBAzaRaM, parihA-soktiH, narmAlApaH; ‘truce to (fie upon) your j(est)s’ DikprahasanaM (

), alaM pari-hAsena; ‘uttered in j(est)’ parihAsajalpitaM; ‘made a j(est) of the matter’ tamarTaM parihAsa-miva mene.
Ⓑ
 2 KelA, krIqA, keli f., kOtukaM; ‘in j(est)’ parihAsena, parihAsapUrvaM.

Ⓝ[Jest]er,Ⓒs.ⒹvEhAsikaH, parihAsayitf m., parihAsa-vinoda-kArin m., BaMqaH, cAwupawuH; ‘kingʼs j(ester)’ vidUzakaH, narma-sacivaH.
Ⓝ[Jest]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹparihAsapUrvaM, sapari-hAsaM, savinodaM.
